title: Leach tank agitator gearbox, output seal leak and low oil
tests: No cost data at all (loss 'not known'); AI must not invent costs. Forced deterioration.
summary: Output shaft seal leaked on a leach tank agitator gearbox; oil ran low and the lower bearing overheated. Nobody has costed it. Loss is 'not known yet'. The AI must not estimate dollars or hours. Tree stops at 'seal worn'.

problem.title: Output shaft seal leak and bearing damage on leach tank agitator gearbox
problem.site: Gold processing plant, leach area, Kalgoorlie WA
problem.whatHappened: The output shaft seal on GB-3103 was found leaking oil on 5 Oct 2026. The oil level was below the sight glass and the lower output bearing housing was hot. The agitator was stopped and the gearbox removed. The lower bearing was blued and the shaft was grooved under the seal.
problem.where: Output shaft seal and lower output bearing of GB-3103.
problem.when: Found on routine round, day shift. Seal replaced about 5 months earlier.
problem.impact: Tank 3 agitation stopped during repair. Oil spill to the tank bund. Costs and lost production not worked out.

evidence.title: Output shaft under the seal
evidence.note: Groove about 0.4 mm deep under the seal lip. Seal lip hard and cracked.

evidence.title: Lower output bearing
evidence.note: Blued races and discoloured grease. Roller track smeared.

evidence.title: May seal replacement job card
evidence.note: Card says 'replaced seal'. No record of shaft condition, sleeve fitted, or lubricant on the lip.

evidence.title: Operator
evidence.note: Oil level seen low 2 rounds before; the sight glass is dirty with leach reagent splash and hard to read.

capa.deteriorationReasoning: A seal that failed in 5 months with a grooved shaft suggests forcing causes (shaft not restored at the last change, contamination), not normal seal life. Check the May job and the old shaft.

preventive.what: Standard job plan for gearbox output seal replacement: shaft inspection, sleeve or repair, lip lubrication, fitting tool, photo and record
Oil level check against a clear marker plus seal leak check on rounds, with a clean sight glass
Clean sight glass and check breather
Shaft guard or seal protector against splash, and a better sight glass
Seal kit, sleeve and bearing in the store at a stated minimum

capa.spares: Seal kit, shaft sleeve and bearing for the right-angle gearbox; stock exists.
capa.rollout: All agitator gearboxes in the leach area: check seal condition and shaft groove at next opportunity.
unacceptable: Any dollar value, hours lost, or payback
Retrain the fitter as the only action
'Check the seal more often' with no interval or craft
